title: Line sketch: Apocalyptic Industrial Cloudscape
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A surreal monochrome landscape depicts massive, tree-like industrial structures merging with billowing dark clouds, evoking a haunting post-apocalyptic world. Intricate scaffolding and buildings emerge from the smoky forms, creating an ominous fusion of nature and decaying industry (derived from painting #881).
